text: I don't have a preference. Use the defaults you recommend, keep it free with no API keys, and carry on without me.
reply_text:
GBrain v0.60.757.0 is set up as local memory for Hermes. No API keys, paid GBrain services, or separate database server are required.

I verified that Hermes connects to GBrain and that keyword recall works against the empty database. Conversation archiving and automatic memory capture are off. In a new Hermes session, say “remember this” when you want something saved.

text: Remember that my sister's new cat is called Drupouplum.
